subject.title: Feature: Show OpenClaw version in sidebar footer

question: Should the apparent current-main sidebar version restoration remain the supported Control UI behavior, reversing the Settings-only direction merged in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99838?
rationale: The latest release and the recent merged product decision remove the badge, but current-main tests and styles appear to restore it; repository history available for this review does not establish whether that reversal is intentional.

options.title: Keep The Restored Badge
options.body: Confirm the current-main sidebar version as intentional, strengthen the rendering assertion, and ship it in the next release.

options.title: Keep Settings Only
options.body: Remove any restored sidebar-version remnants and retain Settings as the supported version-information surface.

recommendation.title: Keep The Restored Badge
recommendation.body: Confirm the current-main sidebar version as intentional, strengthen the rendering assertion, and ship it in the next release.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the recent opposite product decision and the affected Control UI shell implementation.
